target.population: Exactly the six R174 ordinary Validation directions, with the same frozen features, candidates and oriented output boxes
target.aggregation: Equal weight on the six direction means; recording-level paired resampling within each target platform
target.target_labels: Read only the previously sealed and independently audited four subject-slot IoUs after the new prediction seal

fixed.checkpoint: R174 full head of each source, same source backbone, candidate IDs and parser
fixed.role_pools: Original four subject and four reference boxes, with a two-reference truncation tested separately
fixed.score_baseline: Complete R174 full. Existing R174 source-trained 2x2 cells are retained as a separate comparison.

interpretation.unchanged: Numerical endpoint equality and per-record equality are reported separately. Both subject and reference must retain the same boxes for two-role output equivalence.
interpretation.improved: Report every signed point estimate, every paired improvement and harm, and descriptive recording uncertainty. A positive exposed Validation comparison alone does not replace the registered main method.
interpretation.runtime: Measure decoder-only latency on each direction's first full batch after warm-up. Count actual decoded slots, recurrent rounds and terminal message projections. Keep end-to-end claims separate.
interpretation.reference: Report reference box switches and exact same-box assignments on direct left-right records. Box equality is observable without target annotations. It does not measure verified reference identity.
interpretation.retention: Retain all ordinary records, positive and negative cases, ties, and failed attempts.
